title: Spill reference (A1#) tracks dynamic-array extent including 1x1 errors and returns #REF! on non-spills
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, the postfix spill operator A1# resolves to the spilled region anchored at A1 (ROWS(fn2_q009!J20#) = 2 and COLUMNS(fn2_q009!J20#) = 2 for a 2x2 spill; ROWS(J20#) = 1 and COLUMNS(J20#) = 4 in fn7_format_context, with INDEX(J20#,2,1) = #REF!). A dynamic-array formula evaluating to a single error cell still acts as a 1x1 spill anchor (ROWS(fn2_q001!J20#) = 1 where J20 holds =EXPAND(#N/A,0,3,"pad")), whereas referencing a cell with no spilling formula returns #REF! (ROWS(fn2_q123!J20#) = #REF!). In .xlsx files, Excel 16.0 build 20430 saves A1# as _xlfn.ANCHORARRAY(A1), but typing =ANCHORARRAY(B1) or =_xlfn.ANCHORARRAY(B1) at worksheet entry is refused (0x800A03EC).
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0.20527 in fn2_questions (478 observer # formulas across fn2_o001..fn2_o197), fn7_format_context (144 J20# formulas), excel-entry.tsv (B1# and ANCHORARRAY entry probes), and Excel 16.0 build 20430 in d1/excel-file-form.json (lines 291-311).
